[[File:SR_Terminal_Lucky_Carrot.png|thumb|Lucky Carrot is in charge of managing Redistribution of Supplies and Goods.]]
==Overview==
'''{{FULLPAGENAME}}''' is available at [[Authority Level]] 15, after the player completes the '''Restart Area Stock Redistribution I''' mission.

Found by talking with [[Lucky Carrot|"Lucky Carrot"]] around the map, Stock Redistribution Terminals are the main location to use Regional Stock Bills to obtain materials or gifts. It can also be used to buy important items, such as Engraving Permits or Artificing Catalysts. 

All items have a stock limit, with some being one-time purchase or discounted. Some items may also refresh weekly.

When the first Stock Redistribution Terminal reached Level 2, [[Item/Package Items|'''Elastic Goods''']] will be available, which prices change daily. The player can purchase those to sell at a later date, or sell them to friends who has higher prices to gain profit. Purchase of Elastic Goods has a limit which recovers daily and can be accumulated to a limit.

The Terminals can be upgraded using Stock Bills, which can increase the number of types of Elastic Goods, daily limit and maximum limit of purchasing Elastic Goods, as well as the types of items available.
